hints.title: Membership Lookup via Distinct Elements
hints.text: Store all array elements in a fast lookup set to enable constant-time presence checks.

hints.title: Linear Array Iteration
hints.text: Iterate through each element x in the input array and test whether x + 1 exists in the hash set.

hints.title: Duplicate Counting Rule
hints.text: Duplicates in the original array each contribute independently if their successor exists in the set.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of elements in arr
complexity.notes: Constructing hash set takes linear time, and scanning elements executes in linear time with O(1) membership lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the list linearly for each element requires quadratic O(N^2) time comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocating a hash set achieves optimal linear time at the cost of linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Optimal O(N) time using a hash set with proper handling of duplicates in original input.
